programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Majestic View Created by the Nature, Jeju
programme.desc: The natural environment of deep blue sea and steep cliffs under the azure sky makes a majestic view around the island of Jeju. The lava flowed from the volcano of the island created a spectacular landscape in corners of Jeju such as Seongsan Ilchulbong Peak and pillar-shaped cliffs on the coast. The heavenly combination between the sky, the ocean and the bold cliffs by the shore. Here, we present the mysterious land of Jeju.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Island of Wind and Stones
programme.desc: Experience a day in Seongeup Folk Village of Jeju, the island of wind and stones. Jeju has long been referred to samdado (island of three many) because it is abundant with wind, stones and women. The thatched houses in Jeju were wisely constructed with stones as soil is not sufficient, and in a way to embrace strong winds.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Mt. Halla Gave birth to and the Sea embraced, Jeongbang Waterfall, Jeju Island
programme.desc: Jeongbang Waterfall in Jeju Island, or province is the Orient's only seaside fall which its waters drop directly into the sea, the form of which is pretty much rare worldwide.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The landscape of Jeju Island from which you are able to sees Mt. Sanbang
programme.desc: Let's appreciate the diverse appearance of Mt. Sanbang, a mountain which is considered as a signature tourist destination in Jeju due to an wonderful scenery of rising high against the backdrop of the clear and blue sky and the wide plain.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The green life force which was brought on by ocean currents The Colony of Cacti, located at Weolryong-ri, Jeju
programme.desc: In Weolryong-ri, Jeju, you can see the Korea's only and single colony of cacti which are dashed from the tropical region riding on the ocean currents and grow wild.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Cheonjeyeon Warm-Temperate Forest, Jeju
programme.desc: The primitive forest which is deep blue in four seasons

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.desc: When a volcanic erupted here in the shallow sea 1.8 million years ago, the fragmental matters spewed and piled up one by one neatly. And the strata again was eroded by wave and wind for tens of thousand years. The Coast of Yongmeori, located at Sagye-ri, Jeju Province is the product of such processes.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Flower Village Which One Meets in the Sea Yeonsanho Colony in the coast of Jeju
programme.desc: Let's navigate through the flower bed under the sea.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The glistening white field of jewels, Hongjodangoe-haebin of udo, jeju
programme.desc: In the northern coast of Jeju, there are lots of sand beaches and sand dunes which are boastful of their milky color against the blue sea. Most of the beaches are ones consisted of weathered sandy shells but Hongjodangoe-haebin of Udo, Jeju is composed of red algae sand or honjodangoe, not weathered sandy shells.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Lost in the white flagrance, Natural Habitat for Crinum Lilies Rabbit Island's

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: The Bearded Vulture is one of the largest birds of prey in Europe and one of the rarest. With its habitat above the treeline in the alpine mountains, we see one of the largest airworthy birds fly loops during its courtship days and flight for survival on the steep slopes.

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: The Grey Seal is Europe's largest water prediator. With its habitat in the fish rich costal areas in cool but not arctic waters we discover that recreation in the sun plays a major role for the seal, but we also see it raiding in dangerous waters.

programme.title: Frontier Vets
programme.desc: The group discovers Roxanne's childhood fear of lizards. Niven takes the opportunity to exploit it.

programme.title: Frontier Vets
programme.desc: Agatha is feeling motivated again only to learn that she actually failed her exams and must leave the residency.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters
programme.desc: Craig joins Kristina at Sango Lodge in the heart of the Save Valley Conservancy where they explore the vast, rugged wilderness. Kristina joins Byrce Clemence and his anti-poaching team as they demonstrate the effectiveness of the anti-poaching dog unit. Tracking notorious rhino on foot keeps their senses alert. Find out what causes the crew to hit the floor.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters
programme.desc: Back on the banks of Lake Kariba, Kristina is hosted by the luxurious Bumi Hills Safari Lodge. She tracks lions with her guide Madison, witness elephants swimming and challenges Madison to a fishing bet and finally gets to tick an elusive cat off her bucket list.

programme.title: Nature's Weirdest
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most – scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on. Each one finds its own way to exploit and conserve the available food and water in a daily struggle for survival.

programme.title: Dangerous Trails: Elephants in the Minefield
programme.desc: This film tells the story of peace and resettlement in Angola. After decades of civil War, the Elephants are returning via routes riddled with landmines. We show the challenge of both elephants and people reclaiming their land and living together.

programme.title: Crazy Rut Hunting
programme.desc: November, the rut is on, and the Grigsby is home to some of the best whitetail hunting in the Midwest. Strap into your tree stand because you have to put the hours in to shoot a Booner

programme.title: Monster Whitetails of Ohio
programme.desc: John & Beth head to Ohio with the owners of Black Widow Deer Lures, Andy & Janice. Janice harvests her first monster buck and Beth opts for a doe to collect some venison to punch her tag.

programme.title: Exciting Look Back at HECS Moments
programme.desc: This week we open the vault and take a look back at some exciting HECS moments from past seasons. In this highlights episode we'll enjoy the compelling journey in understanding how far we can push HECS technology.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: Join five time UFC Champ, Tim Sylvia, in the outdoors hunting and fishing

programme.title: Pacific Saltwater Bottom Fishing
programme.desc: Jigging spoons for BC coastal halibut and pacific cod

programme.title: Deep in The Skinny
programme.desc: Capt. Nathan Chennaux reunites with old fishing buddy to put the new Towee Skiff to the test. Shallow water redfish beware!

programme.title: Moose on the Menu
programme.desc: Greg's hunting season doesn't go according to plan, but hunting seldom does. On this week's episode Greg and his good friends Kiley & Hailey Topliss try to fill their freezers with big game.

programme.title: Trav’s First BC Black Bear
programme.desc: Travis \"The Timberwolf\", is in BC on a spot and stalk archery black bear hunt. After looking over a ton of bears this season, he has his heart set on taking his first BC black bear with his bow. Being as stealthy as possible Trav and Cheese are able to sneak into 15 yards of the bear and make a great shot. Trav then heads to the kitchen to make a delicious bear ham with the entire hind quarter

programme.title: A Trick or Two for Bass
programme.desc: Today’s destination takes Charlie up to the Land O’ Lakes area of Eastern Ontario for smallmouth bass. Charlie joins up with friend Chris McMillan as the two enjoy a day of bass fishing. The two share techniques for clear water lakes

programme.title: Operation Elk
programme.desc: September is elk season in the Rockies and the boys are in search of their biggest bulls yet.

programme.title: Beauchene Bass Bash
programme.desc: Taylor and Brittany target smallmouth bass in Northwestern Quebec, while exploring the waters of Beauchene Wilderness Lodge

programme.title: Nackawic & Crabbe Mountain Inn
programme.desc: The town of Nackawic is an exceptional ATV Hero as they allow the crossing of the St. John River to connect the southern and northern parts of New Brunswick. Many towns could learn from the welcoming nature of this town. We then head to an ATV friendly Inn to further explore the area

programme.title: Mulies in the Snow
programme.desc: Taylor is Alberta bound in search of mule deer

programme.title: Ice Fishing Wisconsin
programme.desc: We travel to two famous ice fishing destinations in the state of Wisconsin to fish jumbo perch and chase whitefish

programme.title: World Snowmobile HQ & CKX Gear
programme.desc: STV reads a book this week, checks out some gear from CKX and Jeff takes out the crap cans for a ride to see how their running!

programme.title: African Adventure
programme.desc: The Ultimate OATH joins veteran Tim Crawford in South Africa with Cheetah Safaris for a bucket list safari hunt

programme.title: Shiras Moose: The Ghost of Southern Alberta
programme.desc: Steve's pursuit of the elusive Shiras Moose, known as the \"Ghost of Southern Alberta,\" is a culmination of his 12-year quest to complete his North American 29 collection. With dedication and passion, he ventures into the vast wilderness, determined to capture this elusive species on camera

programme.title: The Eastern Cape of South Africa
programme.desc: This week on Americana Outdoors, we're on a journey back to South Africa where we'll take a look at a variety of adventures and what goes on behind the scenes on some hunts.

programme.title: Crossbow Spring Turkey
programme.desc: Taylor goes on a spring turkey hunt in Ontario, and provides key fundamentals for success

programme.title: Elk Fever
programme.desc: This week, we join Gerry Rightmyer as he goes on the elk hunt of a lifetime, finally getting drawn after 16 years.

programme.title: Trails of the French Fry Capital of the World
programme.desc: STV heads back to New Brunswick and hits the trails in the french fry capital of the world.

programme.title: Big Texas Deer Monsters
programme.desc: Blue Collar Adventures gives away a dream hunt to one lucky fan. The winner and his best friend go hunt the famous Sullivan Whitetail ranch for monster bucks

programme.title: Commotion
programme.desc: Brennen heads to Kansas after a couple of years of not drawing a tag. After a bunch of scouting on public land and a few non productive sits, it all comes together during a classic rut hunt over a decoy in late November

programme.title: Kokanee Springs Escape
programme.desc: Jason tees off as Blair runs the cart and the boys explore Crawford Bay, BC and Kokanee Springs Resort

programme.title: Cree River Monsters
programme.desc: Team200 visits the Cree River Lodge in Northern Saskatchewan to hunt giant black bear. Spot & stalk archery action plus monster northern pike!

programme.title: Cold Weather Ducks
programme.desc: Mario heads east to a few different states and ends up in Wyoming at the Weatherby Facility for a tour. To cap things off we get to head out on the river for a very cold and snowy mallard hunt, with a small side of honkers to enjoy.

programme.title: Return To Whitetail - Part 1
programme.desc: After previously guiding a successful hunt earlier in the year in the area, Blake Barnett returns to the Lowrance in the Texas panhandle to hunt whitetail deer

programme.title: Two Great Hog Hunts
programme.desc: fter participating in the Carolina Coyote Classic, John MacPherson is joined by Sean Casey of DNA Firearm systems to go hog hunting. Later he is joined by Adam Simpson for another incredible hog hunt!

programme.title: Sooner" Or Later"
programme.desc: We're headed out to Oklahoma to follow along with the Sharp brothers as they hunt whitetails in their home state. You never know what to expect with these two but one thing you can always rely on is that they always have some big deer to go after!

programme.title: Alaskan Salmon Run
programme.desc: Larysa Switlyk ventures off to Alaska to fill her freezer with salmon and shares her passion of fishing with Mark who was there to help film but later couldn’t take the fly rod out of his hand!

programme.title: Late Season Horseback Bulls - Part 1
programme.desc: Join Mitch and Lynn as they head out by horseback on a high country elk hunt after some late season bulls for their 2nd wedding anniversary. The air is thin and cold but the action is hot and heavy. The horses are saddled and the excitement is high as the romantic couple find bulls on almost every ridge top

programme.title: Hunting Mule Deer - Part 1
programme.desc: Watch this week as Ted, Amber and country music singer Heath Sanders go to hunt mule deer in Texas

programme.title: A Decade of Dominance with Steve Ecklund
programme.desc: Celebrate a decade of wilderness exploration with Steve Ecklund, as he marks ten thrilling years of capturing his hunting adventures on film. From rugged landscapes to awe-inspiring encounters, join him in reliving the exhilarating journey of a true outdoorsman

programme.title: The Clam" Before the Storm"
programme.desc: Capt. Ed Zyak is joined by long time TV host and Banana River native Capt. Blair Wiggins to visit Blair's home waters to find the famed flats unrecognizable. Human impact and runoff have taken their toll, but Capt. Blair and others have a plan.

programme.title: Fly Fishing the Weed Beds
programme.desc: Don and Dale Freschi experience extremely windy conditions that forces them into the weeds for some crazy fishing

programme.title: Chironomids 101
programme.desc: Dale Freschi and good friend Ted MacDonald fly fish a beautiful lake in the Cariboo region of BC using chironomid patterns

programme.title: The Show
programme.desc: Producer Eric Orton travels remote logging roads to witness extreme hatchery operations with Steve Lacasse, Debbie Anderson, and husband Grant Anderson on Northern Vancouver Island

programme.title: Pend Oreille Waterfowl
programme.desc: The Pend Oreille River in northeast Washington is a waterfowl magnet and provided a perfect setting for close friends to enjoy time together in the blind. The ducks and geese keep the guys engaged between stories of days gone by

programme.title: The Importance of Tripods
programme.desc: The tripod is the most important structure to learn, as it serves many purposes. Learn how to build one with Ryan Marshall

programme.title: Hog & Coyote Hunting
programme.desc: John and Sean Casey help out a farmer who is having a problem with wild hogs, then it's coyote time!

programme.title: BC Borderland Bulls
programme.desc: Embark on BC's wilds with hunters Joe Eppele & Steven Dahn. Tracking majestic elk, witness challenges, camaraderie, & nature's beauty unfold. Join the camaraderie, witness the primal connection with nature, and live the hunt like never before

programme.title: Hunting Mule Deer - Part 2
programme.desc: Ted and country music singer, Heath Sanders chase mule deer and then it’s off to do some airgun hunting on some Texas deer!

programme.title: Fall on Stump Lake
programme.desc: Don Freschi and Brian Chan fly fish Stump Lake in the fall using a variety of fly patterns; mainly Baby Damsels, Blobs and Leeches.

programme.title: Cold November Set Up
programme.desc: Scott heads down to Valley Firearms to buy a compact dispatch rifle for the snowmobile. Then he hangs a lynx set and sets up the line on a cold November start to the season

programme.title: Women Best Canada
programme.desc: Women Best Canada

programme.title: The Reason for Monster Whitetails
programme.desc: This week we're hunting with our good friends from The Reason as they head out to try and get some monster whitetails.

programme.title: Return To Whitetail - Part 2
programme.desc: Blake Barnett continues his hunt for old whitetail deer on the Lowrance Ranch of North Texas

programme.title: Archery Buck
programme.desc: We join Dane as he harvests his biggest buck with a bow, and what makes this even more special is that his father JD is behind the camera

programme.title: Spot & Stalk Bow Fishing for Carp
programme.desc: Wes combines archery and fishing and takes on shallow-water carp in southern Saskatchewan

programme.title: Spot & Stalk Bow Fishing for Carp
programme.desc: Wes combines archery and fishing and takes on shallow-water carp in southern Saskatchewan

programme.title: Adventure Day
programme.desc: The Trekkit Crew takes a bunch of first time ATV riders out on brand new Segway ATVs and SxS and have them experience riding the trails. The trip ranges from getting stuck in the mud, rock climbs, and scenic trails

programme.title: Tradition
programme.desc: Josh heads to Camp Dinkota in North Dakota to kick off the late season push and arrows an awesome whitetail. Then Dylan joins Josh in deer camp and only a day later after Josh kills a good buck, Dylan has an opportunity at another great whitetail

programme.title: Kettle Falls Walleye
programme.desc: Bob Loomis and Britton Ransford join Rich Harrod on a walleye fishing adventure to the upper reach of Lake Roosevelt. The fish are numerous and the bite is on in this beautiful part of the Columbia River

programme.title: Texas Gators - Part 2
programme.desc: In part two of a hunt on the Texas coastline, Blake Barnett along with Conservation Equity Partners complete the task of baiting and harvesting alligator.

programme.title: It’s Like Candy for Pike
programme.desc: Today’s destination is Cree Lake in Northern Saskatchewan. When the bite slows, how do you entice the giants? Check out this finesse presentation that always works time and time again on the inactive brutes

programme.title: Iowa Gun Season
programme.desc: Iowa is a magical place where whitetail hunters' dreams can come true. In this episode, Jerry finds himself back in this coveted state chasing some monster bucks with Cole

programme.title: Hog Wild
programme.desc: Gary Bartels and Steve Holden take OATH registered heroes Clint Kelly and Terrance Flemons to Rock Water Ranch in Texas to do population control on hog

programme.title: The Bonnechere Cup
programme.desc: STV heads to Eganville for the Bonnechere Cup but Jeff isn't taking the quick route, he's riding Goldmember to it!

programme.title: Colorado Dream Hunt
programme.desc: A culmination of volunteers and donors come together to give our recipient the absolute hunt of a lifetime! First, we join Dustin on an intense spot n stalk hunt for an elk followed by a good old-fashioned prairie dog shoot.

programme.title: The Stone Oven
programme.desc: In British Columbia, there is a legend of an ancient stone oven that was built in the mountains during construction of the railroad. Josh sets out on a trip to reconnect with his brothers, do some fishing, explore and ultimately search for this 100-year-old oven if he has come all this way, a meal is in order

programme.title: Cash Out Season - Oregon Steens Mule Deer
programme.desc: Kristy Titus prepares for her second mule deer hunt in the coveted Steens Mountain unit in Oregon. Join her as she cashes out her preference points and completes her final hunt as an Oregon resident.

programme.title: Year-End Episode
programme.desc: Wes gives us a look at some of the highlights & unseen footage from the year

programme.title: Hunting for a Giant
programme.desc: Our first hunt takes us along with our recipient Jacob whose dream of taking down a giant bull moose is about to become a reality. Then we join Brody, who is new to hunting but has the big dream of taking a big ol' trophy whitetail buck!

programme.title: Drum Roll
programme.desc: Sandy beaches and driftwood make the perfect spot for wading out into the shallows to kick off spring fishing for freshwater drum. Josh is accompanied by newcomer Joe, and teaches him to navigate the lake in hip waders. In an area ripe with cattails, Josh shows Joe how to harvest and pickle these unsuspected treats

programme.title: Modern Heroes - Part 1
programme.desc: Treestand accidents unfortunately happen every year despite efforts of public awareness. On this episode of Modern Hunter we showcase a mock hunting accident and the modern heroes that are standing by to answer the call.

programme.title: Wild Turkey Confit
programme.desc: Surrounded by endless oaks on the edge of a ranch, Josh sets out to find a spring turkey, the key ingredient in a delicious riverside supper hes planning to make. He is accompanied by Chad, a local archery hunter whos there to help in the hunt and partake in the dinner

programme.title: Fourteen
programme.desc: After a horrible hunt in the Hill Country, Blaine spends his last day in South Texas looking for a unicorn 14-point buck.

programme.title: Redfish, Snook & Pompano Too!
programme.desc: Pompano are known as one of the finest tasting saltwater fish. They are feisty and fight hard for their size. Henry Waszczuk heads to the quaint fishing village of Cortez to tangle with these tasty fish

programme.title: The Maybe Buck
programme.desc: Taylor Partridge's Excalibur crossbow hunt for a MONSTER typical whitetail. A summer's work leads to a decision on whether or not to hunt a deer that turns out to be one of the largest in Canadian Whitetail history.

programme.title: Team200 Canada
programme.desc: Clay Charlton , owner of Take-Em Outfitters, is the newest member of Team200 and shares his 2021 season as he chases giant whitetails in Alberta and Saskatchewan

programme.title: Measure in Memories
programme.desc: Editor-in-Chief Dan Schmidt returns to his roots of shooting, what makes him happy, and explains why you should have no apologies for doing the exact same thing.

programme.title: Nonacho Lake Fishing Adventures
programme.desc: Wes books a self-guided fishing trip north of the 60th parallel and does battle with the monster lake trout swimming within the depths of the 8th largest lake in the NWT

programme.title: Modern Heroes - Part 2
programme.desc: Part two of our Modern Heroes special, features the Rhinelander, Wisconsin volunteer fire department as they answer a call to save a fallen hunter.

programme.title: NHL Best Canada
programme.desc: NHL Best Canada

programme.title: Marlin for Marty
